## Où j'en suis
Built the new dashboard grid behind `dashboards_v2` on branch `tom/dashboard-grid-v2`: `react-grid-layout` with drag and resize, layout persisted server-side via `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout` (localStorage only as an offline fallback), widget sizing through a `useWidgetSize` ResizeObserver hook, `DashboardTile` renamed to `WidgetCard`, plus the Storybook CSS resolution fix; lint and typecheck pass. A draft PR (#418) is open with Priya as UX reviewer, last commit `d2286a0`.

- [en-cours] Draft PR #418 waiting on Priya's UX review of the grid on the iPad.
- [prochaine-étape] Enable `dashboards_v2` for the Zest workspace only in the flags admin, before the demo on Tuesday the 24th.
- [essai-raté] CSS container queries are silently ignored by iOS 15 Safari (Zest's iPads), so they were removed in favour of the ResizeObserver hook.
- [décision] Layout persisted server-side through the existing endpoint, not only localStorage (source: t03)
- [décision] Drop container queries entirely, one sizing system only (source: t09)
- [décision] Flag on for Zest's workspace only, v1 dashboards kept behind the flag until January (source: t15)
